title: Claude Code Has a Setup Assistant Now (Official, Read-Only)
description:
Anthropic quietly shipped an official plugin called Claude Code Setup — and it changes how you onboard onto a codebase. It scans your entire project and tells you exactly what's missing: which hooks to add, which skills to install, which MCP servers fit your stack, which subagents you need, and which slash commands would save you time.

Detects a React project? It suggests Playwright MCP. Detects auth code? It recommends a security reviewer subagent. Then it walks you through setup step by step.

The part most people miss: it's read-only. It never touches your files — it only tells you what to build. Already at 195,000+ installs.

#claude #code #aitools #anthropic #mcpserver
